hero_title: Engineering Excellence for National Defense and Technological Sovereignty
hero_subtitle: To design, develop, and deliver superior defense technology and engineering solutions that ensure national security and promote technological self-reliance.
home_who_we_are_subtitle: The nation's strategic cornerstone for technological sovereignty and industrial self-reliance.
home_who_we_are_mandate: Our commitment is to equip our armed forces with superior technology. By fostering indigenous innovation and developing sovereign capabilities, we are building a secure future and reinforcing national security for generations to come.
home_vision_text: To be a world-class defense industrial complex, recognized for innovation, quality, and our contribution to national sovereignty and industrial development.
home_mission_text: To design, develop, and deliver superior defense technology and engineering solutions that ensure national security and promote technological self-reliance.
home_about_p1: DEIG (Defense Industry Engineering Group) is the nation's strategic cornerstone for technological sovereignty and industrial self-reliance. We integrate a comprehensive network of specialized industries to deliver cutting-edge solutions across the entire defense spectrum.
home_about_p2: Our commitment is to equip our armed forces with superior technology, from advanced armament to secure communications. By fostering indigenous innovation and developing sovereign capabilities, we are building a secure future and reinforcing national security for generations to come.
home_detailed_about_p1: Established in 1991, the Defense Engineering Industry Group (DEIG) is a strategic consortium of specialized engineering and manufacturing facilities focused on developing and producing defense equipment and technologies to meet national security requirements.
home_detailed_about_p2: Our mission is to enhance national defense capabilities through indigenous engineering solutions, reducing dependency on foreign imports while building local expertise and manufacturing capacity.
home_detailed_about_p3: With facilities spread across the country, DEIG employs over 10,000 skilled engineers, technicians, and support staff dedicated to excellence in defense manufacturing and innovation.
home_value_security_desc: Commitment to strengthening national defense capabilities through indigenous solutions.
home_value_innovation_desc: Continuous pursuit of technological advancement and engineering excellence.
home_value_workforce_desc: Investment in human capital and technical expertise to build national capabilities.
home_value_quality_desc: Adherence to international standards and rigorous quality control in all products.
home_industry_divisions_subtitle: The Defense Engineering Industry Group comprises specialized engineering facilities, each focused on different aspects of defense technology and manufacturing.
home_key_capabilities_subtitle: A comprehensive suite of capabilities enabling end-to-end solutions for national defense.
home_capability_mil_prod_desc: End-to-end design, development, and manufacturing of advanced military hardware and defense systems.
home_capability_mfg_eng_desc: Expertise in advanced manufacturing processes, precision engineering, and quality assurance for defense-grade production.
home_capability_rnd_desc: Dedicated R&D centers focusing on next-generation materials, electronics, and autonomous systems.
home_capability_tech_innov_desc: Driving innovation in areas such as C4ISTAR, electronic warfare, and secure communications.
home_capability_logistics_desc: Integrated logistics and supply chain management to ensure operational readiness and lifecycle support.
home_capability_modernization_desc: Leading national efforts in industrial modernization through technology transfer and skills development.
home_achievements_subtitle: Our commitment to excellence has resulted in significant contributions to national defense and industrial capability.
project1_desc: Design and production of indigenous armored personnel carriers with enhanced protection and mobility features for military operations.

Every project we undertake is a testament to our unwavering commitment to technological sovereignty and the safety of our people."

about_header_subtitle: Combining technical expertise with national commitment to advance defense capabilities, engineering innovation, and sustainable industrial growth.
about_intro_title: Pioneering National Defense Through Engineering Excellence
about_intro_p1: The Defense Industry Engineering Group (DEIG) is the nation's strategic cornerstone for technological sovereignty and industrial self-reliance. We integrate a comprehensive network of specialized industries to deliver cutting-edge solutions across the entire defense spectrum.
about_intro_p2: Our commitment is to equip our armed forces with superior technology, from advanced armament to secure communications. By fostering indigenous innovation and developing sovereign capabilities, we are building a secure future and reinforcing national security for generations to come.
about_mission_text: To design, develop, and deliver superior defense technology and engineering solutions that ensure national security and promote technological self-reliance.
about_vision_text: To be a world-class defense industrial complex, recognized for innovation, quality, and our contribution to national sovereignty and industrial development.
about_values_text: Integrity, Excellence, Innovation, Commitment, and Collaboration form the bedrock of our organization and guide our every action.
about_history_subtitle: Our journey is marked by significant milestones, from the inaugural production line to the development of indigenous, cutting-edge defense systems.
about_org_subtitle: Designed for efficiency, our structure enables seamless integration between diverse engineering groups to foster innovation and tackle complex national projects.
about_org_subtitle_new: DEIG is structured to maximize synergy between our specialized engineering divisions. The headquarters provides strategic direction, R&D oversight, and corporate governance, while each industry operates as a center of excellence in its respective domain.
about_strategic_obj_subtitle: Our strategic roadmap is focused on achieving long-term national goals and maintaining a technological edge.
about_obj1_desc: Implement Industry 4.0 principles to enhance efficiency, quality, and production capacity across all divisions.
about_obj2_desc: Expand our research and development capabilities to pioneer next-generation defense technologies and reduce foreign dependency.
about_obj3_desc: Continuously develop our human capital through advanced training and collaboration with academic institutions.
about_obj4_desc: Ensure the reliable supply of state-of-the-art equipment and munitions to meet the evolving needs of our national defense forces.
about_key_capabilities_subtitle: Our core strengths are built on a foundation of deep technical expertise and decades of mission-critical experience.
about_leadership_subtitle: Steered by a dedicated team with extensive experience in military, engineering, and industrial management.
about_facilities_subtitle: Our network of state-of-the-art facilities forms the backbone of our industrial and innovation capacity.
facility_hq_desc: The central hub for strategic command, research, and development, fostering cross-divisional innovation.
facility_zones_desc: Sprawling complexes dedicated to heavy manufacturing, assembly, and systems integration.
facility_labs_desc: Advanced labs for electronics, materials science, ballistics, and environmental testing.
about_quality_subtitle: Our commitment to global standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence is validated by internationally recognized certifications.
quality_safety_policy_desc: We are committed to the highest standards of workplace safety and environmental stewardship in all our operations, adhering to strict national and international protocols to protect our people and our planet.

cert_as9100_text: Represents our adherence to the quality management standard for the Aviation, Space, and Defense industries.
about_partnerships_subtitle: We believe in the power of collaboration to achieve our strategic goals and enhance our technological capabilities.
partnerships_govt_desc: We work in close coordination with the Ministry of Defense and other national security agencies to align our objectives with strategic priorities.
partnerships_local_desc: Building a robust supply chain with trusted partners is critical. We foster long-term relationships based on quality and reliability.
partnerships_tech_desc: We collaborate with leading technology firms and academic institutions to accelerate innovation and co-develop new solutions.
about_achievements_subtitle: Our legacy is defined by landmark projects and significant contributions to national security and industrial progress.
achievement1_desc: Successfully designed, developed, and deployed the nation's first locally-produced Mine-Resistant Ambush Protected vehicle.
achievement2_desc: Established a sovereign, encrypted communications network for critical national security operations.
achievement3_desc: Achieved first international export of locally manufactured defense components, marking a key step in global competitiveness.
about_csr_subtitle: Our commitment extends beyond defense. We are dedicated to building a stronger, more prosperous nation for all.
about_csr_body: DEIG actively invests in community development, environmental sustainability, and educational initiatives. We support local schools with STEM programs, engage in reforestation projects, and provide vocational training to empower the next generation of engineers and technicians.
about_contribution_subtitle: As a strategic national asset, DEIG plays a pivotal role in driving industrial growth, ensuring technological self-reliance, and strengthening national security.
contribution_economic_text: We create thousands of skilled jobs, foster local supply chains, and contribute significantly to the national GDP through advanced manufacturing and technology development.
contribution_tech_text: By developing indigenous defense solutions, we reduce reliance on foreign imports, enhance national self-sufficiency, and retain critical technological expertise within the country.
contribution_security_text: Our primary role is to equip the armed forces with state-of-the-art, reliable, and effective tools, ensuring they are prepared to defend the nation's interests at all times.
about_certs_subtitle: Our commitment to global standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence is validated by internationally recognized certifications.

industry_map_subtitle: Strategically located centers of innovation and production across the nation.
industry_collective_subtitle: From initial concept to lifecycle support, our integrated industries provide a seamless, end-to-end solution for complex defense challenges.

faq1_q: Can I apply for multiple positions?
faq1_a: Yes, you are welcome to apply for any positions for which you meet the qualifications. Please submit a separate application for each role.
faq2_q: How long does the recruitment process take?
faq2_a: The timeline can vary depending on the position, but we typically aim to complete the process within 4-6 weeks from the closing date.
faq3_q: Are there opportunities for students and recent graduates?
faq3_a: Absolutely. We offer various internship and apprenticeship programs. Please check our current openings or submit your CV for future consideration.

production_header_subtitle: Precision, reliability, and innovation are the cornerstones of our production philosophy, ensuring superior quality in every component and system we deliver.
production_overview_body: Our production operations form the backbone of our commitment to national defense. We adhere to rigorous international standards, employing advanced manufacturing techniques and a philosophy of continuous improvement to produce a wide range of defense systems. From raw material processing to final assembly and testing, our integrated capabilities ensure end-to-end quality control and operational excellence.
production_process1_desc: Raw materials are rigorously inspected and prepared. Components are manufactured to exact specifications using precision tools.
production_process2_desc: Components are assembled into subsystems and integrated into the final product by our skilled technicians on specialized production lines.
production_process3_desc: Every product undergoes a comprehensive series of tests and quality assurance checks to ensure it meets our uncompromising standards.
production_tech_cnc_desc: State-of-the-art multi-axis CNC machines for producing complex components with unparalleled precision and consistency.
production_tech_robotics_desc: Utilizing robotic arms for welding, assembly, and material handling to increase efficiency and ensure worker safety.
production_tech_cadcam_desc: Integrated Computer-Aided Design and Manufacturing systems streamline the workflow from digital model to finished part.
production_capacity_item1: Over 1 million square meters of factory space.
production_capacity_item2: Multiple specialized production lines for vehicles, armaments, and electronics.
production_capacity_item3: Annual capacity to produce over 5,000 tactical vehicles.
production_capacity_item4: Advanced laboratories for ballistics, electronics, and materials testing.
production_quality_item1: Fully compliant with ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems.
production_quality_item2: Comprehensive non-destructive testing (NDT) and metallurgical labs.
production_quality_item3: Rigorous field testing in simulated and live environments.
production_quality_item4: Dedicated teams for continuous process and quality improvement.
production_rd_body: Our innovation labs work directly with production teams to pioneer new manufacturing techniques, prototype next-generation components, and implement continuous improvement programs that enhance efficiency and capability.
production_safety_body: We are committed to the highest standards of workplace safety and environmental stewardship. Our facilities operate under strict protocols for waste management, energy efficiency, and worker safety, ensuring compliance with all national and international regulations.
production_achievements_item1: Increase in production efficiency in the last fiscal year.
production_achievements_item2: Quality acceptance rate on all major production lines.
production_achievements_item3: Major international quality and safety certifications awarded.

Your personal information is contained behind secured networks and is only accessible by a limited number of persons who have special access rights to such systems, and are required to keep the information confidential.

procurement_hero_subtitle: Partnering with the best suppliers for national excellence.
procurement_philosophy_strategy_body: Our procurement is guided by principles that ensure we acquire the best value goods and services to support our critical national mission.
procurement_principle1_desc: We conduct all procurement activities with integrity, providing equal opportunities to all qualified suppliers through a clear and open process.
procurement_principle2_desc: We seek competitive bids to ensure best value for money, driving efficiency and innovation in our supply chain.
procurement_principle3_desc: We aim to build strong, long-term relationships with reliable suppliers who share our commitment to quality and national security.
procurement_principle4_desc: We prioritize suppliers who contribute to local industry and technological sovereignty, strengthening our national industrial base.
procurement_step1_desc: Submit your company profile and relevant certifications through our Supplier Registration portal for prequalification.
procurement_step2_desc: Registered suppliers are invited to participate in open tenders that match their capabilities.
procurement_step3_desc: Bids are evaluated based on technical competence, quality, value, and adherence to our code of conduct.
procurement_step4_desc: Successful bidders are awarded contracts and onboarded as official DEIG partners.
procurement_coc_section_body: All suppliers are expected to adhere to our strict Code of Conduct, which ensures our supply chain operates with integrity, quality, and compliance.
procurement_coc_item1: Ethical Standards: Suppliers must adhere to the highest ethical standards, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws.
procurement_coc_item2: Quality Assurance: All products and services must meet or exceed the specifications outlined in the tender documents and comply with relevant international standards.
procurement_coc_item3: Compliance: Suppliers must comply with all applicable national and international laws and regulations.
procurement_coc_item4: Confidentiality: Suppliers must maintain strict confidentiality regarding all DEIG-related information and projects.
supplier_header_subtitle: Join our network of trusted suppliers. Complete the form below to be considered for future procurement opportunities.
supplier_form_success_body: Thank you for your interest in partnering with DEIG. Your submission has been received and will be reviewed by our procurement team. We will contact you if your profile matches our requirements.
